question: Should Feishu video sends perform best-effort inline preview extraction and image upload before creating the video message?
rationale: The patch is bounded and covered, but automation cannot decide whether the extra per-video send-path work is an acceptable product and availability tradeoff for Feishu users.

options.title: Accept bounded preview work
options.body: Merge with the current 5s extraction timeout and fallback because video delivery still proceeds if preview rendering or upload fails.

options.title: Require async or opt-in preview
options.body: Hold the PR until cover generation can avoid adding inline latency to ordinary Feishu video sends.

options.title: Keep current no-cover behavior
options.body: Close or pause the PR if preview covers are not worth adding extra processing and upload work to Feishu video delivery.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded preview work
recommendation.body: Merge with the current 5s extraction timeout and fallback because video delivery still proceeds if preview rendering or upload fails.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the strongest history signal for Feishu media routing and delivery tradeoffs in this path.
